title: Finance Controller
description:
Job Title: Finance Controller Location: Nigeria
 Industry: Agro Commodity 
 Job Summary: 
We are looking for an experienced Finance Controller to manage financial accounting, reporting, reconciliations, working capital, inventory accounting and financial controls for Nigeria operations. 
 Key Responsibilities: Manage day-to-day accounting, monthly closing, P&L, Balance Sheet and financial reporting. Handle bank, supplier, customer, employee and intercompany reconciliations. Manage supplier advances, payables, receivables, inventory and working capital. Reconcile procurement, inventory and accounting records with Operations and Procurement teams. Monitor cash flow, Opex and budget vs. actuals; identify and escalate variances. Ensure statutory compliance, audit readiness and proper financial documentation. Support procurement cost accounting and financial-control processes. Provide regular financial and working-capital reports to Group Finance. 
 Candidate Profile: 10-12 years of relevant finance/accounting experience. Mandatory: Current location in Nigeria. Mandatory: Experience in Agro Commodity Trading industry. CA / ACCA / ICAN or equivalent qualification preferred. Strong experience in inventory accounting, supplier advances, reconciliations and working-capital management. Strong Excel and ERP/accounting-system skills. Good communication skills with the ability to work with international/Group Finance teams. 
 Interested candidates kindly share your updated CV on mariya@upman.in

Key Skills: Financial Reporting,Internal Control,Budgeting,Auditing,Trial Balance,Profit and Loss,Fund Flow Statement,Variance Analysis
